call_distributed_init: initialize the distributed process group using a FairseqConfig and return the rank
call_infer_init_method: infer the distributed init method from environment variables or Slurm config
call_all_gather_list: gather arbitrary picklable Python data from all workers into a single list
call_broadcast_object: broadcast an arbitrary Python object from one rank to all other workers
call_all_reduce_dict: all-reduce a dictionary of tensor and scalar values across distributed workers
